heading: Lost Cities
body: A two-player expedition card game. Play cards to 5 color-coded expeditions, trying to earn points by building profitable routes. The game is played over 3 rounds, and the player with the highest cumulative score wins.

heading: Cards
body:
There are 60 cards in 5 expedition colors (Yellow, Blue, White, Green, Red). Each color has:
  - 3 Investment (wager) cards: multiply your expedition score
  - Numbered cards 2 through 10: add their face value

Each player starts with 8 cards in hand.

heading: Turn Flow
body:
Each turn has two mandatory phases:

1. Play or Discard -- you must play one card from your hand:
   a) Play to expedition: click a card in your hand, then click one of your expedition lanes to place it there.
   b) Discard: click a card in your hand, then click the matching discard pile to discard it.

2. Draw -- you must draw one card:
   a) Draw pile: click the draw pile for an unknown card.
   b) Discard pile: click any non-empty discard pile to take the top card.
   Note: You cannot draw from the pile you just discarded to.

heading: Expedition Rules
body:
Cards in an expedition must follow ascending order:
  - Investment cards must be placed BEFORE any numbered cards.
  - Numbered cards must be placed in strictly ascending rank order.
  - Once you play a numbered card, you can never place an investment or lower-numbered card in that expedition.

Starting an expedition is a commitment -- it costs 20 points before card values are counted.

heading: Scoring
body:
Each expedition is scored independently:
  - Empty expedition: 0 points (no penalty)
  - Started expedition: (-20 + sum of card values) x multiplier
  - Multiplier = 1 + number of investment cards (up to x4)
  - 8+ card bonus: +20 points added after the multiplier

Examples:
  - 1 investment + cards 3,5,7 = (-20 + 15) x 2 = -10
  - Cards 4,6,8,9,10 = (-20 + 37) x 1 = +17
  - 2 investments + cards 2-10 = (-20 + 54) x 3 + 20 = +122

heading: Round End
body:
A round ends immediately when the last card is drawn from the draw pile. Both players' expeditions are scored, and scores accumulate across rounds.

The match consists of 3 rounds. The starting player alternates each round.

heading: Tips
body:
- Investments multiply both gains AND losses -- only invest if you can place many cards.
- Keep track of what the AI discards and picks up to infer their strategy.
- Discarding valuable cards to a pile the opponent is watching can backfire.
- An empty expedition costs nothing -- sometimes it is better not to start one.
- Drawing from the draw pile depletes it faster, bringing the round closer to ending.

heading: Controls
body:
1. Select a card from your hand by clicking it.
2. Click an expedition lane or discard pile to place the selected card.
3. Click the draw pile or a discard pile to draw your next card.

The AI opponent plays automatically after your turn.

Press ? to toggle this help panel.
